units.source_text: 家将被六分的恐怖和四分的好奇心所动了，几乎暂时忘却了呼吸。

en.t: Moved by six parts terror and four parts curiosity, the servant almost forgot to breathe for a time.

units.source_text: 倘借了旧记的记者的话来说，便是觉得“毛戴”起来了。

en.t: To borrow the words of the old chronicler, he felt his hair standing on end.

units.source_text: 随后那老妪，将松明插在楼板的缝中，向先前看定的死尸伸下手去，

en.t: Then the old woman thrust the pine torch into a crack between the floorboards and reached her hand toward the corpse she had already marked out.

units.source_text: 正如母猴给猴儿捉虱一般，一根一根的便拔那长头发。

en.t: Just as a mother monkey picks lice from her young, she pulled out that long hair strand by strand.

units.source_text: 头发也似乎随手的拔了下来。

en.t: The hair, too, seemed to come away easily in her hand.
